english: When something ends up happening the opposite way it was supposed to.
notes: Often used as a shorthand for 'the other way around' in some contexts.
description: It refers to when the opposite of something happens. For example, if you said 'Subuthu hahaen konin ẽ payaru payawanoãieji. Subĩ nasũ ninru ana?' (I wanted to play through the day and study near the time for the exam. I should be able to pass, right?), but failed, then you could say that the apple ate the human. Another example: you devise a plan, pretending to be children; however, when the plan is executed, everyone thinks you're grown men. The apple ate the human!
